description.value: Fable Diner & Bar occupies the base of Vancouver's historic Lee Building on Richards Street, growing out of the farm-to-table tradition established by Fable Kitchen in Kitsilano in 2012. The kitchen crafts nearly everything from scratch using locally sourced BC ingredients, offering a menu that spans hearty breakfasts, eggs benedicts, smash burgers, and cocktails. Named among 2025's top brunch and lunch destinations in Vancouver, it provides a full sit-down dining experience in the heart of downtown.
